name: code-review
title: Code review
description: Adaptable review shell, navigation, findings, and diffs for project or temporary apps. Includes host-token styles and bounded offline syntax highlighting.
docs:
Install this pack as editable source, not as imports from @catamorphic/app/review. Reuse an existing project copy first and preserve its customizations. The files form one directory; keep their relative imports together. Import ReviewShell, ReviewNavigation, ReviewFinding, DiffView and type ReviewView from ./components/catamorphic/code-review.js (adjust for your app location).

ReviewShell is controlled with value/onChange; its overview, guide, changes and discussion props take React content. ReviewNavigation uses the same ReviewView values (overview, guide, diff, discussion). DiffView needs path and either patch or before/after, plus layout (split/unified), wrap and their change callbacks. ReviewFinding takes title, source { file, revision, line, side } and onOpenSource. All styles use host theme tokens, with no Tailwind setup required. Keep compared revisions and evidence links explicit; local discussion must not claim an external comment was posted.

Install the declared npm dependencies in a React 19 app. Existing hosts may keep their full Shiki bundle, particularly when other editors need more languages or themes. For a standalone review app, optionally configure an exact shiki alias to the installed review-highlighter.ts in your bundler. For Vite, merge resolve.alias: [{ find: /^shiki$/, replacement: fileURLToPath(new URL('./src/components/catamorphic/review-highlighter.ts', import.meta.url)) }] into the EXISTING config, importing fileURLToPath from node:url. Adjust the path to where you installed the files. Preserve React dedupe, production define, IIFE output and the host scaffold. Do not alias shiki subpaths. This bounds the offline syntax bundle to JavaScript, TypeScript, JSX, TSX, JSON, CSS, HTML, Python, SQL, YAML and Bash; other languages remain readable as text.

For temporary apps, copy the returned components into the session_artifact files map under apps/<name>/src/components/catamorphic/, include the dependency manifest and merged vite.config.ts under apps/<name>/, and import the local barrel in your app source. Fetching a pack alone does not install it. Do not write these files to the user's project for a temporary review. Choose a short descriptive title and the canonical review icon with set_app_presentation. Build and visually verify the resulting app before opening it for the user.
